verdict.rationale: Okta publishes an official open-source MCP server (github.com/okta/okta-mcp-server) that connects LLMs and AI agents to Okta's Admin Management APIs. A first-party blog post announces it, and the README shows natural-language operations such as creating users, auditing failed logins, and listing unused apps. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that agents connect successfully, and evidence of setup, auth and transport configuration details for MCP clients.
